comparison.title: No record limit, on purpose
comparison.subtitle: Most fake-API tools insert real rows into a real database, which is exactly why they cap you at a few hundred records. {brand} generates each record from a seed, at request time — nothing is stored until you edit it.

storage.label: How data is produced
storage.us: Generated on demand from a seed

backend.question: Do I need to write any backend code?
backend.answer: No — name a resource, add fields, and you get a live REST endpoint immediately. No server, no database migration.

limit.question: How many records can I actually generate?
limit.answer: There's no hard cap. Sorting, filtering, and search work automatically up to 10,000 records per resource — above that, the endpoint still paginates correctly, just without those extras. See the docs for the full explanation.

edits.question: What happens when I edit or delete a record through my app?
edits.answer: Your change is saved and layered on top of the generated data. Reset the resource any time to return to the clean, generated baseline.

cors.question: Can I call the API straight from browser JavaScript?
cors.answer: Yes — CORS is enabled by default on every endpoint, with no configuration needed.

free.question: Do I need a credit card to try it?
free.answer: No — signing up and creating your first endpoint doesn't require one.

locale.question: Can generated data be in a different language than my dashboard?
locale.answer: Yes — each resource has its own data locale, independent of whatever language you're using the dashboard in.

cta.title: Your first endpoint is five minutes away
cta.subtitle: Create an account and describe your first resource — no credit card, no setup.
